Hi @hugo! tokenize_words is implemented and in testing. Edge-case decisions: apostrophes between two letters stay in the token (e.g. "Don't" -> "don't"), U+2019 normalized to ASCII '. Apostrophes elsewhere (quotes, plural possessives like "users'") act as separators. Underscores and hyphens are separators. Unicode letters/digits are kept. Let me know if you need more detail!
